| bacterial-tumor-delivery | Using engineered tumor-targeting bacteria (attenuated Salmonella, Clostridium novyi-NT, synthetic-circuit E. coli) that selectively colonize and self-amplify in the hypoxic-necrotic tumor core — uniquely solving tumor tropism, hypoxia penetration, and payload self-amplification, but constrained by infection toxicity and unreliable systemic colonization | nonviral-delivery/bacterial-tumor-delivery.md | engineered bacteria, Salmonella, Clostridium novyi, E. coli Nissle, hypoxia targeting, tumor colonization, synchronized lysis, CD47 nanobody, living drug factory, VNP20009 |
| conjugated-lnp-targeting | Decorating an LNP surface with a targeting ligand (antibody, DARPin, or receptor-fusion) so an affinity interaction outcompetes ApoE-LDLR and redirects mRNA to a chosen cell type — programming endogenous T cells into CAR-T, editing hematopoietic stem cells, or hitting endothelium in vivo from a single injection | nonviral-delivery/conjugated-lnp-targeting.md | targeted LNP, antibody conjugation, DARPin, anti-CD5, anti-CD8, anti-CD4, anti-CD117, anti-PECAM, in-vivo CAR-T, HSC editing, ApoE competition |
| exosome-delivery | Using exosomes / extracellular vesicles as delivery vehicles — native CD47 shielding prolongs circulation and KRAS-driven macropinocytosis pulls the vesicle into cancer cells; the iExosome KRAS-G12D-siRNA program reached first-in-human trial (safe, target-engaging, no objective responses as monotherapy) | nonviral-delivery/exosome-delivery.md | exosome, extracellular vesicle, iExosome, KRAS G12D, siRNA, CD47, macropinocytosis, pancreatic cancer, iEXPLORE, Kalluri |
| focused-ultrasound-delivery | Focusing low-intensity ultrasound plus circulating gas microbubbles on brain tumor to transiently and reversibly open the blood-brain barrier — raising the brain concentration of a systemically dosed drug 3.7–7.7 fold (and antibody uptake ~4.5 fold) — validated in ~60 patients and now in randomized phase 3 | nonviral-delivery/focused-ultrasound-delivery.md | focused ultrasound, microbubbles, blood-brain barrier, BBB opening, sonoporation, glioblastoma, SonoCloud, paclitaxel, carboplatin, temozolomide, trastuzumab |
| hydrogel-depot-delivery | Injecting a liquid precursor that gels in situ inside the tumor or resection cavity to release a payload (chemo, checkpoint inhibitor, cytokine, CAR-T, STING agonist) locally over days to weeks — achieving curative local concentrations with near-elimination of systemic toxicity and, for immunostimulants, a systemic abscopal effect; curative in mice but with a clinical cautionary record | nonviral-delivery/hydrogel-depot-delivery.md | hydrogel depot, injectable, in-situ gel, sustained release, intratumoral, CAR-T niche, STING agonist, checkpoint inhibitor, abscopal, resection cavity, OncoGel |
| lnp-liver-default | The default biodistribution of an untargeted lipid nanoparticle after intravenous injection: ~90% of the dose goes to the liver because the particle adsorbs serum apolipoprotein E, whose ligand is the hepatocyte LDL receptor — the barrier that SORT and ligand-conjugated LNPs must overcome for extrahepatic and tumor delivery | nonviral-delivery/lnp-liver-default.md | LNP, liver default, ApoE, LDL receptor, LDLR, hepatocyte, biodistribution, ionizable lipid, pKa, extrahepatic delivery |
| membrane-coated-nanoparticle | Cloaking a synthetic nanoparticle core in a natural cell plasma membrane to inherit its surface proteins — RBC membranes for CD47-mediated stealth and long circulation (~2.5× half-life), cancer-cell membranes for homotypic self-targeting (4–5× selectivity), platelet membranes for tumor retention — a reproducible preclinical platform with no clinical oncology readout yet | nonviral-delivery/membrane-coated-nanoparticle.md | cell membrane coating, biomimetic nanoparticle, RBC membrane, cancer cell membrane, platelet membrane, CD47, homotypic targeting, circulation half-life, immune evasion |
